title: THE SECRET UNDERGROUND CITY OF EUROPEAN BADGERS
caption: European badgers build and maintain underground homes called setts. 🦡 #EuropeanBadger #AnimalBehavior #Wildlife #NatureFacts #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: That quiet forest floor may hide an entire badger neighborhood.
narration_timeline.scene: Open on wild badgers near their den

narration_timeline.text: European badgers dig underground homes called setts, with several entrances and chambers.
narration_timeline.scene: Show badgers at/near a sett rather than CGI tunnels

narration_timeline.text: Families rest there during daylight and raise their cubs safely below ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Switch to family/cub footage as family life is discussed

narration_timeline.text: At dusk, they emerge to search for earthworms, insects, and fruit. Badgers also groom one another, while young cubs learn through play.
narration_timeline.scene: Show wild movement, grooming and play as those behaviors are spoken

narration_timeline.text: Some setts are enlarged and reused for years, although family sizes vary with food and habitat.
narration_timeline.scene: Return to den/family visuals during the sett longevity explanation

narration_timeline.text: The surprise? Beneath an ordinary patch of woodland, generations of badgers may be maintaining a secret underground home.
narration_timeline.scene: End on a strong family/den payoff
